newsitem.title: UK: Allen to acquire P.S.Turner for 8.7 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Allen to acquire P.S.Turner for 8.7 mln stg.

text.p: Diversified construction group Allen Plc on Monday said it acquired the entire issued share capital of P.S. Turner Holdings Ltd and its subsidiaries for an initial 8.7 million stg in cash.

Allen, whose activities range from hire services to housebuilding and civil engineering contracting, said P.S. Turner was a well-established business with major construction projects set up nationally.

The initial consideration is subject to the audited agreed value of net assets as at May 2, 1997, but will not exceed 8.85 million stg. A further 268,000 stg in cash may become due in June 1998 based on the amount by which the audited pre-tax profits for the year to April 30, 1998, exceed 2.7 million.
